user.title: Set up MeatPi device
user.description:
MeatPi devices (WiCAN and future products) are usually discovered automatically. Use manual setup only if automatic discovery failed.

Enter the hostname or IP address of your device.

data_description.mdns: The mDNS hostname (e.g. wican_xxxx.local) or IP address that Home Assistant uses to reach the device.
data_description.host: An optional alternative IP address to try if the hostname cannot be resolved.

reconfigure.description: Update the address Home Assistant uses to reach this device.

create_entry.default:
To send events to Home Assistant, you will need to set up a webhook.

Open the device's web interface and go to *Settings → Services → Automation → Webhooks*

Enable *Webhooks* and fill in the following webhook in the URL field:

`{webhook_url}`

Home Assistant also registers this automatically when it can reach the device. See [the documentation]({docs_url}) for further details.

data_description.post_interval: How often the device pushes data to Home Assistant.
data_description.history_sync: When the device reconnects after being away, import the data it logged to its SD card into each sensor's long-term statistics (hourly resolution). Requires the data logger to be enabled on the device.

webhook_registration_failed.title: MeatPi device unreachable
webhook_registration_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not register its webhook with the device "{device}" after several attempts (tried: {endpoints}).

Until this is resolved the device will not push updates. Please check that:

1. The device is powered on and connected to the network.
2. Home Assistant can reach the device at the address above.
3. The device firewall allows connections on port 80.

The issue clears automatically once registration succeeds.
